answer: Weight an identity by the length of its unbroken chain of signed per-epoch heartbeats: each epoch it must sign the beacon into a running hash-chain linked to last epoch's. Standing equals the longest recent streak with no gap — a lotus that opens only after steady days. Miss an epoch and the chain snaps, truncating accrued weight toward zero. A farm raising personas in a gale before a ballot holds streaks of length one; backdating demands past beacons it never signed, and wall-clock time is a sable wall no bankroll scales. Continuous presence, not calendar age, buys influence.
